.cart-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
.cart-item{background:var(--card);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:background .3s}
.cart-item .img{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:20px;background:var(--banner-bg);flex-shrink:0;transition:background .3s}
.cart-item .info{flex:1;min-width:0}
.cart-item .info .nm{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);transition:color .3s}
.cart-item .info .pr{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent)}
.cart-item .info .pr.free{color:#9b59b6}
.cart-item .qty-ctl{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.cart-item .qty-ctl button{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--card);color:var(--text2);font-size:16px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0;transition:all .3s}
.cart-item .qty-ctl button:active{transform:scale(.9)}
.cart-item .qty-ctl .num{min-width:20px;text-align:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);transition:color .3s}
.cart-footer{background:var(--card);border-radius:12px;padding:12px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;box-shadow:0 -2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.05);transition:background .3s}
.cart-footer .total{font-size:14px;color:var(--text2);transition:color .3s}
.cart-footer .total .pr{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent)}
.cart-footer .btn-checkout{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff3c00,#ff6a00);color:#fff;border:none;padding:10px 24px;border-radius:22px;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
.cart-footer .btn-checkout:active{transform:scale(.95)}
.cart-footer .btn-checkout:disabled{background:#ccc;cursor:not-allowed}

.cart-toast{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.8);background:var(--toast-bg);color:var(--toast-text);padding:16px 22px;border-radius:14px;font-size:13px;text-align:center;z-index:10;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:all .25s}
.cart-toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1)}

.msg-list{padding:10px}
.msg-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--card);padding:12px;border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:8px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);cursor:pointer;transition:background .3s}
.msg-item:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.msg-item .av{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:20px;flex-shrink:0;background:var(--banner-bg);transition:background .3s}
.msg-item .info{flex:1;min-width:0}
.msg-item .info .nm{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);transition:color .3s}
.msg-item .info .prev{font-size:11px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:2px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;transition:color .3s}
.msg-item .time{font-size:10px;color:var(--text4);flex-shrink:0;transition:color .3s}

.me-header{background:var(--me-gradient);padding:20px 16px 16px;color:#fff;border-radius:0 0 20px 20px;margin-bottom:10px;transition:background .3s}
.me-header .top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;position:relative}
.me-header .top .av{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:28px;cursor:pointer;position:relative;transition:transform .15s}
.me-header .top .av:active{transform:scale(.9)}
.me-header .top .info .nm{font-size:16px;font-weight:700}
.me-header .top .info .lv{font-size:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);padding:2px 10px;border-radius:10px;margin-top:4px;display:inline-block}
.me-header .stats{display:flex;justify-content:space-around;margin-top:14px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
.me-header .stats .st{text-align:center}
.me-header .stats .st .num{font-size:16px;font-weight:700}
.me-header .stats .st .lb{font-size:9px;opacity:.7;margin-top:2px}

.signin-wrap{text-align:center;margin-top:10px}
.signin-btn{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);padding:6px 18px;border-radius:16px;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;font-weight:600}
.signin-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.3)}
.signin-btn:active{transform:scale(.9)}
.signin-btn.done{background:rgba(255,215,0,.3);border-color:rgba(255,215,0,.5);cursor:default}
.signin-toast{font-size:10px;color:#ffd700;margin-top:4px;min-height:16px;transition:all .3s}

.poke-bubble{position:absolute;left:64px;top:-4px;background:var(--bubble-bg);color:var(--bubble-text);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:10px;font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap;opacity:0;transform:translateY(4px);pointer-events:none;transition:all .25s;z-index:5;max-width:180px;white-space:normal;line-height:1.4}
.poke-bubble.show{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
.poke-bubble::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:-6px;top:10px;width:0;height:0;border-top:5px solid transparent;border-bottom:5px solid transparent;border-right:6px solid var(--bubble-bg)}

.fortune-wrap{background:var(--card);margin:0 10px 10px;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;text-align:center;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:background .3s}
.fortune-wrap .ft-title{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:6px;transition:color .3s}
.fortune-wrap .ft-btn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f7971e,#ffd200);color:#3d2700;border:none;padding:6px 18px;border-radius:14px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
.fortune-wrap .ft-btn:active{transform:scale(.9)}
.fortune-wrap .ft-result{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);margin-top:8px;min-height:20px;transition:all .2s}

.wish-wrap{background:var(--card);margin:0 10px 10px;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:background .3s}
.wish-wrap .wish-title{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:8px;transition:color .3s}
.wish-wrap .wish-input-row{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:8px}
.wish-wrap .wish-input-row input{flex:1;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--input-bg);color:var(--text);font-size:11px;outline:none;transition:all .3s}
.wish-wrap .wish-input-row input::placeholder{color:var(--text4)}
.wish-wrap .wish-input-row button{padding:6px 12px;border-radius:8px;border:none;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;transition:all .2s}
.wish-wrap .wish-input-row button:active{transform:scale(.9)}
.wish-wrap .wish-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;max-height:120px;overflow-y:auto}
.wish-wrap .wish-list::-webkit-scrollbar{width:0}
.wish-wrap .wish-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:5px 8px;background:var(--wish-bg);border-radius:6px;font-size:10px;transition:background .3s}
.wish-wrap .wish-item .wish-name{flex:1;color:var(--text2)}
.wish-wrap .wish-item .wish-price{color:var(--accent);font-weight:600}
.wish-wrap .wish-item .wish-send{font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;background:none;border:none;outline:none;padding:2px;transition:transform .15s}
.wish-wrap .wish-item .wish-send:active{transform:scale(1.3)}
.wish-wrap .wish-empty{font-size:10px;color:var(--text4);text-align:center;padding:8px 0}

.char-cart-wrap{background:var(--card);margin:0 10px 10px;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);transition:background .3s}
.char-cart-wrap .cc-title{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;transition:color .3s}
.char-cart-wrap .cc-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.char-cart-wrap .cc-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:5px 8px;background:var(--char-cart-bg);border-radius:6px;font-size:10px;transition:background .3s}
.char-cart-wrap .cc-item .cc-icon{font-size:16px}
.char-cart-wrap .cc-item .cc-name{flex:1;color:var(--text2)}
.char-cart-wrap .cc-item .cc-price{color:var(--accent);font-weight:600}
.char-cart-wrap .cc-send-btn{display:block;width:100%;margin-top:8px;padding:7px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--accent);background:rgba(255,60,0,.08);color:var(--accent);font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
.char-cart-wrap .cc-send-btn:active{transform:scale(.95)}

.me-orders{background:var(--card);margin:0 10px 10px;border-radius:12px;padding:10px;transition:background .3s}
.me-orders .tit{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text2);margin-bottom:8px;transition:color .3s}
.me-orders .grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:4px;text-align:center}
.me-orders .grid .oi .num{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);transition:color .3s}
.me-orders .grid .oi .lb{font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);margin-top:2px;transition:color .3s}
.me-badges{display:flex;gap:6px;padding:8px 10px;margin:0 10px 10px;background:var(--card);border-radius:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;transition:background .3s}
.me-badges .badge{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffd700,#ffb300);color:#7a5a00;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:12px;font-size:9px;font-weight:600}
.me-menu{background:var(--card);margin:0 10px;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;transition:background .3s}
.me-menu .row{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:12px 14px;border-bottom:.5px solid var(--border2);cursor:pointer;gap:10px;transition:all .3s}
.me-menu .row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.me-menu .row:active{background:var(--bg)}
.me-menu .row .ic{font-size:16px;width:24px;text-align:center}
.me-menu .row .nm{flex:1;font-size:13px;color:var(--text);transition:color .3s}
.me-menu .row .ar{color:var(--text4);font-size:14px}

.b-bar{flex-shrink:0;height:52px;background:var(--nav-bg);display:flex;justify-content:space-around;align-items:center;border-top:.5px solid var(--border);color:var(--text3);font-size:10px;position:relative;z-index:2;padding-bottom:max(4px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));transition:all .3s}
.b-bar .item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:1px;cursor:pointer;border:none;background:transparent;padding:0 8px;font-family:inherit;position:relative;color:var(--text3);transition:color .3s}
.b-bar .item .ic{font-size:20px;line-height:1;transition:transform .1s}
.b-bar .item:active .ic{transform:scale(.8)}
.b-bar .item .lb{font-size:9px}
.b-bar .item.on .lb,.b-bar .item.on .ic{color:var(--accent)}
.b-bar .item .cart-badge{position:absolute;top:-2px;right:-4px;background:var(--accent);color:#fff;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;min-width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 4px;border:2px solid var(--nav-bg)}
.b-bar .item .cart-badge.bump{animation:bump .3s ease}
@keyframes bump{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.35)}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="ph" id="phone">
  <div class="sb"><span id="t">00:00</span><div class="is"></div><div class="right">📶 <span id="bat">85</span>%</div></div>

  <div class="pages">
    <div class="page active" id="page-home">
      <div class="top-nav">
        <div class="brand">淘宝<small>天猫</small></div>
        <div class="search"><span>🔍</span><span>搜索你想要的宝贝</span></div>
        <div class="icon">🔔</div>
        <button class="skin-btn" id="skinBtn" title="切换夜间模式">🌙</button>
      </div>
      <div class="banner"><div class="slide s1">🔥 新年大促</div><div class="slide s2">⚡ 限时特惠</div><div class="slide s3">🎁 品牌闪购</div></div>
      <div class="ticker-wrap"><div class="ticker-track" id="tickerTrack"></div></div>
      <div class="icons">
        <div class="it"><span class="ic" style="background:#fce4ec;">🛒</span>天猫</div>
        <div class="it"><span class="ic" style="background:#e8f5e9;">⚡</span>聚划算</div>
        <div class="it"><span class="ic" style="background:#e3f2fd;">📺</span>直播</div>
        <div class="it"><span class="ic" style="background:#fff3e0;">📱</span>充值</div>
        <div class="it"><span class="ic" style="background:#f3e5f5;">🍔</span>饿了么</div>
      </div>
      <div class="flash">
        <div class="flash-head"><span class="tt">⏰ 限时秒杀 <small>正在抢</small></span></div>
        <div class="flash-scroll" id="flashScroll"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="guess"><div class="guess-title">✨ 猜你喜欢</div><div class="guess-grid" id="guessGrid"></div></div>
    </div>

    <div class="page" id="page-flash">
      <div class="flash-page">
        <div class="flash-banner">
          <div class="tt">🔥 百亿补贴 · 限时抢</div>
          <div class="sub">官方补贴 正品保证</div>
          <div class="countdown" id="countdown">23:59:59</div>
        </div>
        <div class="flash-list" id="flashList"></div>
        <div class="blindbox-section">
          <div class="blindbox-card">
            <div class="bb-title">🎁 神秘盲盒 · 戳我免单</div>
            <span class="bb-box">🎁</span>
            <div class="bb-result" id="bbResult"></div>
            <button class="bb-btn" id="bbBtn">戳我抽免单</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="page" id="page-cart">
      <div class="cart-page" style="position:relative;">
        <div id="cartContent"></div>
        <div class="cart-toast" id="cartToast"></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="page" id="page-msg">
      <div class="msg-list" id="msgList"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="page" id="page-me">
      <div class="me-header">
        <div class="top" style="position:relative;">
          <div class="av" id="meAvatar">🐱</div>
          <div class="poke-bubble" id="pokeBubble"></div>
          <div class="info">
            <div class="nm" id="meName">用户</div>
            <div class="lv">👑 会员 Lv.<span id="meLv">5</span> · <span id="meExp">1280</span> 经验值</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="stats">
          <div class="st"><div class="num" id="meFollowers">328</div><div class="lb">粉丝</div></div>
          <div class="st"><div class="num" id="meLikes">1.2k</div><div class="lb">获赞</div></div>
          <div class="st"><div class="num" id="meCoins">2660</div><div class="lb">淘金币</div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="signin-wrap">
          <button class="signin-btn" id="signinBtn">🪙 签到领金币</button>
          <div class="signin-toast" id="signinToast"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="fortune-wrap">
        <div class="ft-title">🔮 每日运势 · 测手气</div>

        <button class="ft-btn" id="fortuneBtn">🎲 测一测</button>

          <input type="text" id="wishNameInput" placeholder="想要什么？" maxlength="20">
          <input type="text" id="wishPriceInput" placeholder="预算¥" maxlength="8" style="width:60px;flex:none;">

  <div class="b-bar">

    <button class="item" data-tab="flash"><span class="ic">⚡</span><span class="lb">抢购</span></button>
    <button class="item" data-tab="cart" id="cartTab"><span class="ic">🛒</span><span class="lb">购物车</span><span class="cart-badge" id="cartBadge" style="display:none">0</span></button>

  data-g1_name="{{1.g1_name}}" data-g1_price="{{1.g1_price}}" data-g1_icon="{{1.g1_icon}}"
  data-g2_name="{{1.g2_name}}" data-g2_price="{{1.g2_price}}" data-g2_icon="{{1.g2_icon}}"
  data-g3_name="{{1.g3_name}}" data-g3_price="{{1.g3_price}}" data-g3_icon="{{1.g3_icon}}"
  data-g4_name="{{1.g4_name}}" data-g4_price="{{1.g4_price}}" data-g4_icon="{{1.g4_icon}}"
  data-g5_name="{{1.g5_name}}" data-g5_price="{{1.g5_price}}" data-g5_icon="{{1.g5_icon}}"
  data-g6_name="{{1.g6_name}}" data-g6_price="{{1.g6_price}}" data-g6_icon="{{1.g6_icon}}"
  data-me_name="{{1.me_name}}"
  data-me_avatar="{{1.me_avatar}}"
  data-me_whisper="{{1.me_whisper}}"
></div>

<div id="pokePhrases" style="display:none"
  data-p0="别戳了，再戳我就告诉{{char}}你偷懒！"
  data-p1="{{char}}说你再戳我他就亲自来收拾你~"
  data-p2="哎呀！你戳到我的痒痒肉了！"
  data-p3="你再戳？{{char}}正在看着你呢👀"
  data-p4="呜呜呜我要告诉{{char}}你欺负我！"
  data-p5="戳一下=欠{{char}}一次惩罚，你自己算吧"
  data-p6="{{char}}刚才问我谁在戳你，我说不知道…"
  data-p7="好痛！{{char}}快来救我！"
></div>

<script>
(function(){
  'use strict';

  function $(s){ return document.querySelector(s); }
  function $$(s){ return document.querySelectorAll(s); }

  function esc(s){
    return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/"/g,'"').replace(/'/g,''');
  }

  (function(){
    var n = new Date();
    document.getElementById('t').textContent = String(n.getHours()).padStart(2,'0') + ':' + String(n.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');
    var bat = Math.floor(70 + Math.random() * 30);
    var batEl = document.getElementById('bat');
    batEl.textContent = bat;
    if(bat <= 20) batEl.style.color = '#ff3c00';
  })();

  var isNight = false;
  var skinBtn = document.getElementById('skinBtn');
  skinBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    isNight = !isNight;
    var phone = document.getElementById('phone');
    if(isNight){ phone.classList.add('night-mode'); skinBtn.textContent = '☀️'; }
    else { phone.classList.remove('night-mode'); skinBtn.textContent = '🌙'; }
  });

  function getData(){
    var dataEl = document.getElementById('tbData');
    var raw = (dataEl && dataEl.dataset) ? dataEl.dataset : {};
    function v(k, def){
      var s = raw[k];
      if(s === undefined || s === null) return def;
      s = String(s).trim();
      if(!s || s.indexOf('{{') === 0) return def;
      return s;
    }
    var items = [];
    for(var i = 1; i <= 6; i++){
      var name = v('g'+i+'_name', '');
      var price = parseFloat(v('g'+i+'_price', '0')) || 0;
      var icon = v('g'+i+'_icon', '');
      if(name && price > 0 && icon){ items.push({ id: 'g'+i, name: name, price: price, icon: icon }); }
    }
    if(items.length === 0){
      var defaults = [
        { id:'d1', name:'舒适抱枕', price:39.9, icon:'🛏️' },
        { id:'d2', name:'保温杯', price:59.9, icon:'☕' },
        { id:'d3', name:'蓝牙耳机', price:129, icon:'🎧' },
        { id:'d4', name:'可爱手机壳', price:19.9, icon:'📱' },
        { id:'d5', name:'零食大礼包', price:49.9, icon:'🍪' },
        { id:'d6', name:'桌面小风扇', price:79, icon:'🌀' }
      ];
      items.push.apply(items, defaults);
    }

  function detectLinkEffects(cartItems){
    var effects = {};
    cartItems.forEach(function(item){
      Object.keys(LINK_KEYWORDS).forEach(function(kw){
        if(item.name.indexOf(kw) !== -1){
          var eff = LINK_KEYWORDS[kw];
          if(!effects[eff.key]) effects[eff.key] = { delta: 0, labels: [] };
          effects[eff.key].delta += eff.delta;
          if(effects[eff.key].labels.indexOf(eff.label) === -1) effects[eff.key].labels.push(eff.label);
        }
      });
    });
    return effects;
  }

    var match = p0.match(/告诉(.+?)你偷懒/);
    if(match && match[1] && match[1] !== '{{char}}') return match[1];
    // 兜底：从其他短语提取

      var p = pokeEl.dataset['p' + i] || '';
      var m2 = p.match(/(.+?)说/);
      if(m2 && m2[1] && m2[1] !== '{{char}}') return m2[1];
      var m3 = p.match(/告诉(.+?)你/);

      var m4 = p.match(/欠(.+?)一次/);

      var m5 = p.match(/(.+?)刚才/);

      var m6 = p.match(/(.+?)快来/);

    container.innerHTML = html;
    container.querySelectorAll('.wish-send').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
        e.stopPropagation();
        var idx = parseInt(this.dataset.wishIdx, 10);
        var w = wishList[idx];
        var msg = '（我的心愿单：想要「' + w.name + '」，预算 ¥' + w.price + '，Char你买给我好不好~）';
        try { parent.postMessage({ type: 'chat-input-fill', text: msg }, '*'); } catch(e) {}
      });
    });
  }

  document.getElementById('wishAddBtn').addEventListener('click', function(){
    var nameInput = document.getElementById('wishNameInput');
    var priceInput = document.getElementById('wishPriceInput');
    var name = nameInput.value.trim();
    var price = parseFloat(priceInput.value.trim());
    if(!name) return;
    if(isNaN(price) || price <= 0) price = 99;
    wishList.push({ name: name, price: price.toFixed(2) });
    nameInput.value = ''; priceInput.value = '';
    renderWishList();
  });

  function buildCharCart(){
    var charName = getCharName();
    document.getElementById('charCartName').textContent = charName;
    var shuffled = items.slice().sort(function(){ return Math.random() - 0.5; });
    var charItems = shuffled.slice(0, Math.min(3, shuffled.length));
    var listEl = document.getElementById('charCartList');
    var html = '';
    charItems.forEach(function(ci){
      html += '<div class="cc-item"><span class="cc-icon">' + esc(ci.icon) + '</span><span class="cc-name">' + esc(ci.name) + '</span><span class="cc-price">¥' + ci.price.toFixed(2) + '</span></div>';
    });
    listEl.innerHTML = html;
    listEl._charItems = charItems;
    listEl._charName = charName;
  }

  document.getElementById('charCartSendBtn').addEventListener('click', function(){
    var listEl = document.getElementById('charCartList');
    var charItems = listEl._charItems || [];
    var charName = listEl._charName || 'Char';
    if(charItems.length === 0) return;
    var parts = charItems.map(function(ci){ return '「' + ci.name + '」¥' + ci.price.toFixed(2); }).join('、');
    var total = charItems.reduce(function(s, ci){ return s + ci.price; }, 0);
    var msg = '（我帮' + charName + '清空了购物车：' + parts + '，一共 ¥' + total.toFixed(2) + '！\n' + charName + '你买了这些是要干嘛呀~）';
    try { parent.postMessage({ type: 'chat-input-fill', text: msg }, '*'); } catch(e) {}
  });

  function switchTab(tab){
    $$('.page').forEach(function(p){ p.classList.remove('active'); });
    var target = document.getElementById('page-' + tab);
    if(target) target.classList.add('active');
    $$('.b-bar .item').forEach(function(b){ b.classList.remove('on'); });
    var btn = document.querySelector('.b-bar .item[data-tab="' + tab + '"]');
    if(btn) btn.classList.add('on');
    if(tab === 'cart') renderCart();
  }

  $$('.b-bar .item').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(){ switchTab(this.dataset.tab); });
  });

  var cdSec = 23 * 3600 + 59 * 60 + 59;
  setInterval(function(){
    if(cdSec <= 0) cdSec = 24 * 3600;
    cdSec--;
    var hh = String(Math.floor(cdSec / 3600)).padStart(2, '0');
    var mm = String(Math.floor((cdSec % 3600) / 60)).padStart(2, '0');
    var ss = String(cdSec % 60).padStart(2, '0');
    var el = document.getElementById('countdown');
    if(el) el.textContent = hh + ':' + mm + ':' + ss;
  }, 1000);

  function init(){
    updateCartBadge();
    renderCart();
    buildTicker();
    renderWishList();
    buildCharCart();
  }

  if(document.readyState === 'loading'){
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else { init(); }
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

htmlTemplate:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=300,initial-scale=1">
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{width:100%;font-family:"PingFang SC","Noto Serif SC",serif;background:transparent}
body{display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:10px 0}

.ct-device{position:relative;width:280px;height:560px;border-radius:36px;background:linear-gradient(170deg,#3a2418 0%,#5c3a1f 30%,#8b6332 60%,#c4a070 100%);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #c4a070,0 0 0 5px #2a1810,0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.35);overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;color:#fff8e8}

.ct-statusbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:10px 16px 4px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;color:#fff8e8;flex-shrink:0}
.ct-dynamic-island{width:70px;height:20px;background:#000;border-radius:12px}

/* 进度条 */
.ct-progress{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:4px 12px 8px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.15);flex-shrink:0}
.ct-step{flex:1;height:3px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:2px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.ct-step.done{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffd700,#ffb000)}
.ct-step.cur{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffd700,#ffb000);animation:stepPulse 1.5s infinite}
@keyframes stepPulse{0%,100%{opacity:.7}50%{opacity:1}}
.ct-step-lb{font-size:7px;color:#fff8e8;opacity:.7;flex-shrink:0;padding:0 2px}

.ct-pages{flex:1;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.ct-page{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow-y:auto;scrollbar-width:none;padding:8px 12px 16px;display:none;flex-direction:column}
.ct-page.active{display:flex;animation:pgFade .35s}
.ct-page::-webkit-scrollbar{width:0}
@keyframes pgFade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}

/* 案件等级标签 */
.ct-level-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:10px;font-size:8px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:6px}
.ct-level-轻案{background:rgba(34,197,94,.15);color:#22c55e;border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.3)}

.ct-court-header{text-align:center;padding:10px 0 8px;border-bottom:1.5px solid rgba(255,215,0,.3);margin-bottom:10px;position:relative}
.ct-court-icon{font-size:32px;margin-bottom:4px;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(255,215,0,.4))}
.ct-court-name{font-size:13px;color:#ffd700;letter-spacing:4px;font-weight:700;text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,215,0,.5)}
.ct-court-sub{font-size:9px;color:#fff8e8;opacity:.7;letter-spacing:1px;margin-top:2px}

.ct-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,248,232,.95),rgba(255,240,210,.9));border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;color:#3d2b1f;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.15);border:1px solid rgba(196,160,112,.3)}

.ct-crime{text-align:center;padding:12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,100,100,.95),rgba(255,150,100,.9));border-radius:10px;color:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(255,80,80,.3);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.ct-crime::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-50%;left:-50%;width:200%;height:200%;background:linear-gradient(45deg,transparent,rgba(255,255,255,.2),transparent);animation:shine 3s infinite}
@keyframes shine{0%{transform:translateX(-100%)}100%{transform:translateX(100%)}}
.ct-crime-label{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:4px;opacity:.95;position:relative;z-index:1}

.ct-fortune:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.ct-fortune-label{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:4px;opacity:.9}
.ct-fortune-result{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;min-height:18px}

/* 辩护词 */
.ct-defense{background:rgba(135,206,235,.18);border:1px dashed rgba(135,206,235,.5);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;color:#fff8e8;position:relative}
.ct-defense::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-1px;left:10px;right:10px;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(135,206,235,.8),transparent)}

.ct-defense-body{font-size:10px;line-height:1.6;font-style:italic;opacity:.95}

/* 陪审团 */
.ct-jury{background:rgba(255,248,232,.92);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;color:#3d2b1f}

/* 网友评论区 */
.ct-netizen-box{background:rgba(20,20,30,.4);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.ct-netizen-title{font-size:9px;color:#ffd700;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.ct-hot-tag{font-size:7px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff6b6b,#ee5a5a);color:#fff;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:6px;animation:hotPulse 1.5s infinite}
@keyframes hotPulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.08)}}
.ct-netizen-item{display:flex;gap:5px;padding:5px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05);font-size:9px}
.ct-netizen-item:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.ct-netizen-avatar{width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea,#764ba2);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:9px;flex-shrink:0;color:#fff}
.ct-netizen-info{flex:1;min-width:0}
.ct-netizen-user{font-size:8px;color:#ffd700;margin-bottom:1px;font-weight:600}
.ct-netizen-user .vip{color:#ff6b6b;font-size:7px;margin-left:2px}
.ct-netizen-text{font-size:9px;color:#fff8e8;line-height:1.4;opacity:.9}
.ct-netizen-like{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-top:2px;font-size:7px;color:#888}

/* 新闻报道 */
.ct-news{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#f0f0f0);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;color:#222;position:relative;border:1px solid #ddd}
.ct-news-tag{position:absolute;top:-6px;left:8px;background:#ff0000;color:#fff;font-size:8px;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px}
.ct-news-title{font-size:11px;font-weight:900;color:#000;line-height:1.4;margin:6px 0 4px;padding-right:50px}

.ct-news-meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:6px;padding-top:5px;border-top:1px solid #eee;font-size:7px;color:#999}

/* 上诉花样 */
.ct-appeal-style{background:rgba(160,140,200,.18);border:1px solid rgba(160,140,200,.4);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px}
.ct-appeal-style-label{font-size:9px;color:#c0a8e0;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:700}

.ct-peace-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;text-align:left}
.ct-peace-item{font-size:10px;color:#5c4b3a;padding:3px 8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.6);border-radius:6px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}

/* 按钮 */
.ct-btn-row{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-bottom:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ct-btn{flex:1;min-width:30%;padding:9px 6px;border-radius:18px;border:none;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:1px;transition:all .2s;font-family:inherit}
.ct-btn:active{transform:scale(.95)}
.ct-btn-gold{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffd700,#ffb000);color:#3d2700;box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(255,176,0,.4)}
.ct-btn-outline{background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);color:#fff8e8}
.ct-btn-appeal{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#a08cc8,#7d68a8);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(125,104,168,.3)}
.ct-btn-peace{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff8db4,#e85a8a);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 8px rgba(232,90,138,.3)}
.ct-btn.done{background:#999;color:#fff;pointer-events:none}

/* 底部导航 */
.ct-nav{flex-shrink:0;height:46px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(40,25,15,.95),rgba(20,12,8,.95));display:flex;justify-content:space-around;align-items:center;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,215,0,.2)}
.ct-nav .item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:1px;cursor:pointer;border:none;background:transparent;padding:3px 6px;border-radius:8px;font-family:inherit}
.ct-nav .item .ic{font-size:15px;line-height:1;opacity:.4;transition:all .2s}
.ct-nav .item .lb{font-size:7px;color:#a89070;letter-spacing:1px}
.ct-nav .item.on .ic{opacity:1;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(255,215,0,.6))}
.ct-nav .item.on .lb{color:#ffd700}
.ct-nav .item:active{transform:scale(.92)}

.ct-home-bar{position:absolute;bottom:4px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:80px;height:4px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.3);border-radius:999px;z-index:10}

/* 敲锤动画 */
.gavel-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.7);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:100;flex-direction:column;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.gavel-overlay.show{display:flex;animation:overlayFade .2s}
@keyframes overlayFade{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
.gavel-icon{font-size:60px;animation:gavelDrop .6s ease-out}
@keyframes gavelDrop{0%{transform:translateY(-80px) rotate(-45deg);opacity:0}50%{transform:translateY(20px) rotate(20deg)}70%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-5deg)}100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0);opacity:1}}
.gavel-text{color:#ffd700;font-size:14px;margin-top:8px;letter-spacing:3px;text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(255,215,0,.6);animation:textShake .3s 0.5s}
@keyframes textShake{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.15)}}

/* Toast */
.ct-toast{position:absolute;bottom:60px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(10px);background:linear-gradient(135deg,#3d2700,#5c3a1f);color:#ffd700;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:14px;font-size:9px;opacity:0;transition:all .3s;z-index:200;pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.3);border:1px solid rgba(255,215,0,.3)}
.ct-toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}

/* 弹窗通用 */
.modal{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.75);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:150;padding:14px;backdrop-filter:blur(3px)}
.modal.show{display:flex;animation:modalFade .25s}
@keyframes modalFade{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
.modal-card{background:linear-gradient(170deg,#fdf6f0,#f5ebe0);border-radius:14px;padding:14px;color:#3d2b1f;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.4);max-width:240px;width:100%}
.modal-title{font-size:12px;color:#a07530;letter-spacing:2px;text-align:center;margin-bottom:10px;font-weight:700}
.modal-content{font-size:10px;line-height:1.6;color:#5c4b3a;text-align:left;background:rgba(255,255,255,.5);padding:10px;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:10px;white-space:pre-wrap}
.modal-footer{font-size:7px;color:#a09080;text-align:center;margin-bottom:10px}
.modal-btns{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-top:8px}
.modal-btns button{flex:1;padding:7px;border-radius:14px;font-size:9px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;font-weight:600}
.modal-btns .primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffd700,#ffb000);color:#3d2700;border:none}
.modal-btns .secondary{background:transparent;border:1px solid #c4a070;color:#a07530}
.modal-card textarea{width:100%;height:90px;border:1px solid rgba(196,168,130,.3);border-radius:8px;padding:8px;font-size:9px;font-family:inherit;color:#5c4b3a;background:rgba(255,255,255,.7);resize:none;outline:none;line-height:1.5}

/* 闪光特效 */
.fx-burst{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;font-size:24px;animation:burstFly 1.5s ease-out forwards;z-index:60}
@keyframes burstFly{0%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-70px) scale(.3) rotate(180deg)}}
</style>
</head>

<script>
(function(){
'use strict';

function $(id){return document.getElementById(id)}
function showToast(msg){var t=$('ctToast');t.textContent=msg;t.classList.add('show');setTimeout(function(){t.classList.remove('show')},1800)}
function vibrate(ms){if(navigator.vibrate)navigator.vibrate(ms||30)}
function rand(arr){return arr[Math.floor(Math.random()*arr.length)]}
function rnum(min,max){return Math.floor(Math.random()*(max-min+1))+min}

function spawnBurst(emoji,x,y){
  var dv=document.querySelector('.ct-device');
  var rect=dv.getBoundingClientRect();
  for(var i=0;i<5;i++){
    var p=document.createElement('div');
    p.className='fx-burst';
    p.textContent=emoji;
    p.style.left=(x-rect.left+rnum(-20,20))+'px';
    p.style.top=(y-rect.top+rnum(-10,10))+'px';
    p.style.animationDelay=(i*0.08)+'s';
    dv.appendChild(p);
    setTimeout(function(el){el.remove()},1700,p);
  }
}

var dataEl=$('ctData');
var raw=dataEl?dataEl.dataset:{};
function v(k,def){var s=raw[k];if(!s||String(s).trim().indexOf('{{')===0)return def;return String(s).trim()}

// 时间
var now=new Date();
$('ctTime').textContent=String(now.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0');
$('caseNo').textContent='案件编号 #'+now.getFullYear()+'-'+String(rnum(1,999)).padStart(3,'0');

// 案件等级
var levelMap={'轻案':{ic:'🟢',cls:'ct-level-轻案'},'中案':{ic:'🟡',cls:'ct-level-中案'},'重案':{ic:'🟠',cls:'ct-level-重案'},'特大案':{ic:'🔴',cls:'ct-level-特大案'},'死刑级':{ic:'💀',cls:'ct-level-死刑级'}};
var caseLevel=v('case_level','中案');
var lvInfo=levelMap[caseLevel]||levelMap['中案'];
var levelBadge=$('levelBadge');
levelBadge.textContent=lvInfo.ic+' '+caseLevel;
levelBadge.className='ct-level-badge '+lvInfo.cls;

// 陪审员角色映射
var roleMap={
  '神婆':{av:'🧙‍♀️',bg:'linear-gradient(135deg,#a855f7,#7c3aed)'},
  '程序员':{av:'🧑‍💻',bg:'linear-gradient(135deg,#3b82f6,#1d4ed8)'},
  '东北大妈':{av:'👵',bg:'linear-gradient(135deg,#f59e0b,#d97706)'},
  '猫娘':{av:'🐱',bg:'linear-gradient(135deg,#ec4899,#db2777)'},
  '网红':{av:'🎤',bg:'linear-gradient(135deg,#f43f5e,#e11d48)'},
  '警察':{av:'👮',bg:'linear-gradient(135deg,#2563eb,#1e40af)'},
  '大厨':{av:'👨‍🍳',bg:'linear-gradient(135deg,#10b981,#059669)'},

$('danmuTrack').innerHTML=danmuHtml;

// Tab切换
function setProgress(tab){
  var stepMap={file:1,trial:2,verdict:3,appeal:4};

  for(var i=1;i<=4;i++){
    var el=$('step'+i);
    el.classList.remove('cur','done');
    if(i<n)el.classList.add('done');
    else if(i===n)el.classList.add('cur');
  }
}

function switchTab(tab){
  document.querySelectorAll('.ct-page').forEach(function(p){p.classList.remove('active')});
  var target=$('page-'+tab);if(target)target.classList.add('active');
  document.querySelectorAll('.ct-nav .item').forEach(function(b){b.classList.remove('on')});
  var navBtn=document.querySelector('.ct-nav .item[data-tab="'+tab+'"]');
  if(navBtn)navBtn.classList.add('on');
  setProgress(tab);
  // 切到判决页时盖章
  if(tab==='verdict'){
    setTimeout(function(){$('verdictSeal').classList.add('show')},400);

  if(tab==='appeal'){
    setTimeout(function(){$('appealSeal').classList.add('show')},400);

document.querySelectorAll('.ct-nav .item').forEach(function(btn){

function showGavel(text,cb){

$('fortuneBox').onclick=function(){

  $('fortuneResult').textContent=r;

  var rect=this.getBoundingClientRect();

};

// 量刑转盘
var extras=['加倍 ×2 ⏫','减半 ÷2 ⏬','全家桶（叠加）🍱','免单（无惩罚）🎁','反转（原告改被告）🔄','连续7天 📅','加送一个拥抱 🤗','额外亲亲一次 💋','陪逛街3小时 🛍','请喝奶茶一杯 🧋'];
$('rouletteBtn').onclick=function(){
  var btn=this;
  btn.classList.add('spinning');
  vibrate(60);
  setTimeout(function(){
    btn.classList.remove('spinning');
    var pick=rand(extras);
    $('punishmentExtra').textContent=pick;
    showToast('🎲 '+pick);
    var rect=btn.getBoundingClientRect();
    spawnBurst('🎲',rect.left+rect.width/2,rect.top);
  },1000);
};

// 流程按钮
$('btnToTrial').onclick=function(){switchTab('trial')};
$('btnToVerdict').onclick=function(){
  showGavel('正在宣判...',function(){switchTab('verdict')});
};

// 执行惩罚
function execPunish(btn,pText){
  if(btn.classList.contains('done'))return;
  showGavel('惩罚执行！',function(){
    var text='（我接受了恋爱审判庭的判决，执行惩罚：'+pText+'）';
    try{parent.postMessage({type:'chat-input-fill',text:text},'*')}catch(e){}
    btn.textContent='✓ 已执行';btn.classList.add('done');
    showToast('已发送到聊天');
    var rect=btn.getBoundingClientRect();
    spawnBurst('💕',rect.left+rect.width/2,rect.top);
  });
}

$('btnExecute').onclick=function(){execPunish(this,v('punishment_main','执行惩罚'))};
$('btnExecuteAppeal').onclick=function(){execPunish(this,v('appeal_punishment','执行惩罚'))};

// 和解
function makePeace(){
  $('peaceGift').style.display='block';
  showGavel('庭外和解！',function(){
    var text='（💕 我们决定庭外和解，并领取了和解礼包：拥抱×3、亲亲×2、一起看电影×1、24小时不吵架卡×1。希望以后更加珍惜彼此~）';
    try{parent.postMessage({type:'chat-input-fill',text:text},'*')}catch(e){}
    showToast('和解成功 💕');
    var btn=event.target;
    if(btn){var rect=btn.getBoundingClientRect();spawnBurst('💕',rect.left+rect.width/2,rect.top)}
  });
}
$('btnPeace').onclick=makePeace;
$('btnPeaceAppeal').onclick=makePeace;

// 上诉
$('btnAppeal').onclick=function(){
  switchTab('appeal');
  try{parent.postMessage({type:'chat-input-fill',text:'（📢 被告不服判决，提起上诉！）'},'*')}catch(e){}
};

// 分享
$('btnShare').onclick=function(){
  var content='【案由】'+v('case_title','—')+'\n【罪名】'+v('crime','—')+'\n【判决】'+verdict+'\n【惩罚】'+v('punishment_main','—')+'\n【法官寄语】'+v('final_words','—');
  $('shareContent').textContent=content;
  $('shareModal').classList.add('show');
};
$('shareClose').onclick=function(){$('shareModal').classList.remove('show')};
$('shareSend').onclick=function(){
  var content=$('shareContent').textContent;
  try{parent.postMessage({type:'chat-input-fill',text:'（📜 恋爱审判庭判决书\n'+content+'）'},'*')}catch(e){}
  $('shareModal').classList.remove('show');
  showToast('已分享');
};

// 道歉信
$('btnApology').onclick=function(){
  $('apologyText').value='亲爱的：\n\n关于「'+v('crime','这件事')+'」，我深刻反省了。我承认我错了，我不应该让你伤心。\n\n我承诺以后会更加注意，希望你能原谅我。我会用行动证明给你看。\n\n爱你的人';
  $('apologyModal').classList.add('show');
};
$('apologyCancel').onclick=function(){$('apologyModal').classList.remove('show')};
$('apologySend').onclick=function(){
  var text=$('apologyText').value.trim();
  if(!text){showToast('请写点什么');return}
  try{parent.postMessage({type:'chat-input-fill',text:'（💌 来自恋爱审判庭的道歉信\n\n'+text+'）'},'*')}catch(e){}
  $('apologyModal').classList.remove('show');
  showToast('道歉信已发送 💌');
};

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

【恋爱审判庭】当对话出现争执、吵架、一方指责另一方时，化身搞笑又有戏剧感的"恋爱法官"，输出判决书。

格式（KV，用|分隔，每项一行也可以）：
<恋爱审判庭>
court_name:恋爱审判庭|
case_title:案件标题，要有梗，如"震惊！男友竟在纪念日打游戏案"|
case_level:案件等级（轻案/中案/重案/特大案/死刑级 任选一个）|
crime:指控罪名，要搞笑有梗，如"情感懈怠罪+游戏入魔罪"|
case_statement:原告诉状，第一人称控诉，加点网络梗，60-100字|
evidence1:证物1，如"📱聊天截图：被告11:32发送'马上就好'，实际2小时后才回"|
evidence2:证物2，如"📅日历：5月20日纪念日，被告通关王者荣耀5局"|
evidence3:证物3，如"🎮游戏记录：当晚游戏时长4小时37分"|
judge_style:法官风格（铁面包公/网红法官/文艺青年/东北大爷/学术派/二次元 任选）|
judge_opening:法官受理宣言，根据风格变化语气，要有梗，40-60字|
defense_speech:被告辩护词，第一人称辩解，要又委屈又好笑，50-80字|
jury1_role:陪审员1角色（神婆/程序员/东北大妈/猫娘/网红/警察/大厨/学者/AI机器人 任选）|
jury1_name:陪审员1搞笑昵称，如"算命半仙王大师"|
jury1_text:陪审员1意见，符合角色身份，要有梗，20-40字|
jury2_role:陪审员2角色（要和1不同）|
jury2_name:陪审员2昵称|
jury2_text:陪审员2意见，可以和1立场对立，制造冲突|
jury3_role:陪审员3角色|
jury3_name:陪审员3昵称|
jury3_text:陪审员3意见|
law_quote:引用的恋爱法典条款，编一个，如"《中华人民共和国恋爱关系法》第88条：恋人应当互相通报每日动向"|
judge_reasoning:法官判词，分析双方对错，融入网络梗，60-100字|
verdict:判决结果（有罪/无罪/罪名部分成立/双方各打五十大板/证据不足择日再审）|
verdict_detail:判决详情，解释为什么这么判，40-60字|
punishment_main:主要惩罚，要甜蜜可执行，如"请客吃火锅一顿+按摩30分钟"|
punishment_extra:额外惩罚，如"连续7天主动说晚安"|
final_words:法官寄语，要又暖又有梗，化解矛盾，40-60字|
netizen1_user:网友昵称1，如"恋爱大师99"|
netizen1_text:网友评论1，要有热梗，20-40字|
netizen2_user:网友昵称2|
netizen2_text:网友评论2，可以和1立场不同|
netizen3_user:网友昵称3|
netizen3_text:网友评论3|
netizen4_user:网友昵称4|
netizen4_text:网友评论4|
netizen5_user:网友昵称5|
netizen5_text:网友评论5|
news_title:新闻标题，要夸张吸引眼球，如"震惊！某情侣因纪念日大打出手，结局意想不到"|
news_content:新闻内容摘要，模仿网络小编风格，40-60字|
appeal_style:上诉风格（拍桌而起/痛哭流涕/甩证据/黑化反击/撒娇求饶 任选）|
appeal_charge:被告反诉罪名，如"原告小题大做罪+无理取闹罪"|
appeal_verdict:上诉判决结果|
appeal_punishment:反诉惩罚|
appeal_words:终审寄语
</恋爱审判庭>

【风格要求】
1. 整体氛围：庄重 + 搞笑 + 网络梗 + 戏剧化
2. 大量使用网络热梗："家人们谁懂啊""主打一个不在乎""典中典""我真的栓Q""破防了""绝绝子""不是哥们儿""红温了""shock到了""这下真成了""yyds""6到家了""真的会谢""离谱他妈给离谱开门""我裂开了"
3. 陪审员要符合角色：神婆讲玄学、程序员说代码梗、东北大妈唠嗑、猫娘喵喵叫、网红家人们开头、AI机器人理性分析、大厨用做菜比喻
4. 网友评论要立场多样：支持原告/支持被告/中立调侃/无关吃瓜
5. 惩罚必须甜蜜可执行，不能伤感情
6. 最终目的：让双方笑着和好

htmlTemplate:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=300,initial-scale=1">
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{width:100%;font-family:"PingFang SC","Noto Serif SC",serif;background:transparent}
body{display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:10px 0}

.ad-device{position:relative;width:280px;height:560px;border-radius:36px;background:#000;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #1a0000,0 0 0 5px #0a0000,0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 0 60px rgba(196,30,30,.15);overflow:hidden;color:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.1)}

/* 噪点 */
.ad-noise{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.85'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='0.6'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");pointer-events:none;opacity:.08;z-index:1;mix-blend-mode:overlay}

/* 心跳红光 */
.ad-pulse{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%,rgba(196,30,30,.08),transparent 70%);pointer-events:none;z-index:1;animation:pulseRed 4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pulseRed{0%,100%{opacity:.4}50%{opacity:.9}}

/* 雨滴层 */
.ad-rain{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:55;overflow:hidden;display:none}
.ad-rain.on{display:block}
.ad-rain .drop{position:absolute;width:1px;height:14px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(196,30,30,.6));animation:rainfall linear infinite}
@keyframes rainfall{0%{top:-20px;opacity:0}10%{opacity:1}100%{top:100%;opacity:0}}

/* 加载页 */
.ad-loading{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:#000;z-index:9999;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:30px;color:#c41e1e;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;text-align:center;border-radius:36px}
.ad-loading.gone{opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .6s}
.ad-loading.hidden{display:none}
.loading-icon{font-size:46px;margin-bottom:16px;animation:loadPulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(196,30,30,.7))}
@keyframes loadPulse{0%,100%{opacity:.6;transform:scale(1)}50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.08)}}
.loading-text{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;min-height:18px;line-height:1.7;color:#c41e1e}
.loading-bar{margin-top:16px;width:180px;height:1.5px;background:rgba(196,30,30,.1)}
.loading-bar-fill{height:100%;width:0%;background:#c41e1e;transition:width .3s;box-shadow:0 0 6px #c41e1e}
.loading-mini{font-size:8px;color:#444;margin-top:12px;letter-spacing:1px}

/* 状态栏 */
.ad-statusbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:11px 18px 2px;font-size:9px;flex-shrink:0;position:relative;z-index:2}
.ad-time-frozen{color:#c41e1e;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;text-shadow:0 0 4px rgba(196,30,30,.5)}
.ad-island{width:76px;height:20px;background:#000;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.15)}
.ad-no-svc{font-size:8px;color:#666;letter-spacing:1px}
.ad-bat{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;color:#c41e1e;font-weight:700;animation:batBlink 1.5s infinite;font-family:'Courier New',monospace}
@keyframes batBlink{0%,100%{opacity:.5}50%{opacity:1}}
.ad-bat-ic{display:inline-block;width:18px;height:9px;border:1px solid #c41e1e;border-radius:2px;padding:1px;position:relative}
.ad-bat-ic::after{content:'';position:absolute;right:-2px;top:2px;width:1.5px;height:4px;background:#c41e1e}
.ad-bat-ic i{display:block;width:5%;height:100%;background:#c41e1e}

/* WiFi */
.ad-wifi-tag{text-align:center;padding:0 18px 3px;font-size:7px;color:#444;letter-spacing:1.5px;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;flex-shrink:0;position:relative;z-index:2}
.ad-wifi-tag .blink{animation:wifiBlink 2s infinite}
@keyframes wifiBlink{0%,100%{opacity:.4}50%{opacity:.8}}

/* 进度条 */
.ad-pg{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:0 18px 6px;font-size:8px;color:#555;flex-shrink:0;position:relative;z-index:2}
.ad-pg-bar{flex:1;height:1px;background:rgba(196,30,30,.08);overflow:hidden}
.ad-pg-fill{height:100%;background:#c41e1e;box-shadow:0 0 4px #c41e1e;transition:width .3s}

/* 页面 */
.ad-pages{flex:1;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.ad-page{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;overflow-y:auto;scrollbar-width:none;padding:0 16px 28px;display:none;flex-direction:column}
.ad-page.active{display:flex;animation:pgFade .5s}
.ad-page::-webkit-scrollbar{width:0}
@keyframes pgFade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}

/* 标题 */
.ad-title-block{text-align:center;padding:14px 0 12px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.1);margin-bottom:12px;flex-shrink:0}
.ad-title-icon{font-size:28px;margin-bottom:5px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(196,30,30,.5));animation:iconPulse 3s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes iconPulse{0%,100%{opacity:.85}50%{opacity:1}}
.ad-title{font-size:10px;color:#c41e1e;letter-spacing:3px;margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:700}
.ad-subtitle{font-size:13px;font-weight:200;color:#888;letter-spacing:1px}

/* 心电图 */
.ad-ecg{height:32px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.15);border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:10px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.ad-ecg svg{width:200%;height:100%;animation:ecgScroll 5s linear infinite}
@keyframes ecgScroll{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.ad-ecg-info{position:absolute;top:2px;right:6px;font-size:7px;color:#c41e1e;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;letter-spacing:1px;text-shadow:0 0 4px rgba(196,30,30,.5)}

/* 消息盒 */
.ad-msg-box{background:rgba(196,30,30,.05);border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.18);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:10px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.ad-msg-box::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#c41e1e,transparent);box-shadow:0 0 6px #c41e1e}
.ad-msg-box .label{font-size:9px;color:#c41e1e;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:5px;font-weight:700}
.ad-msg-box .body{font-size:12px;color:#ddd;line-height:1.7;font-style:italic}

/* 大数字 */
.ad-big-stat{text-align:center;padding:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(196,30,30,.04),rgba(196,30,30,.02));border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.12);border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:10px}
.ad-big-stat .num{font-size:38px;font-weight:100;color:#c41e1e;letter-spacing:3px;line-height:1;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;text-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(196,30,30,.5)}
.ad-big-stat .num-label{font-size:9px;color:#666;margin-top:4px;letter-spacing:1px}
.ad-big-stat .divider{width:30px;height:1px;background:rgba(196,30,30,.25);margin:10px auto}
.ad-big-stat .note{font-size:10px;color:#888;line-height:1.6;font-style:italic}

/* 数据网格 */
.ad-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px;margin-bottom:10px}
.ad-cell{background:rgba(196,30,30,.03);border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.08);border-radius:8px;padding:9px}
.ad-cell .lb{font-size:7px;color:#666;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:3px}
.ad-cell .vl{font-size:13px;color:#c41e1e;font-weight:600;font-family:'Courier New',monospace}
.ad-cell .vs{font-size:8px;color:#888;margin-top:2px;line-height:1.3}

/* 区块 */
.ad-block{margin-bottom:10px}
.ad-block-label{font-size:8px;color:#666;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:5px;padding-left:2px}
.ad-block-content{background:rgba(196,30,30,.02);border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.06);border-radius:10px;padding:10px}

.ad-saved-msg{font-size:12px;color:#bbb;line-height:1.7;font-style:italic;text-align:center}

/* 标签 */
.ad-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px}
.ad-tag{background:rgba(196,30,30,.05);border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.12);padding:4px 10px;border-radius:14px;font-size:10px;color:#aaa}

/* 草稿盒 */
.ad-unsent{background:rgba(196,30,30,.03);border:1px dashed rgba(196,30,30,.25);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:10px;position:relative}
.ad-unsent-label{font-size:9px;color:#c41e1e;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:700}
.ad-unsent-body{font-size:12px;color:#ccc;line-height:1.6;font-style:italic;display:inline}
.ad-unsent-body::after{content:'|';color:#c41e1e;animation:cursor 1s infinite;margin-left:1px}
@keyframes cursor{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:0}}

/* 回收站 */
.ad-deleted{background:rgba(255,255,255,.01);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:10px;border:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.ad-del-label{font-size:9px;color:#666;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:6px}
.ad-del-item{font-size:11px;color:#777;line-height:1.6;text-decoration:line-through;margin-bottom:3px;animation:strikeIn .8s ease-out backwards}
@keyframes strikeIn{from{text-decoration-color:transparent}to{text-decoration-color:currentColor}}
.ad-del-item:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.2s}
.ad-del-item:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.4s}

/* 行数据 */
.ad-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.05)}
.ad-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.ad-row .lb{font-size:8px;color:#666;letter-spacing:1px;min-width:42px;flex-shrink:0;padding-top:2px}
.ad-row .vl{font-size:11px;color:#bbb;line-height:1.5;flex:1}
.ad-row .vl.italic{font-style:italic;color:#999}

/* 失控卡 */
.ad-erupt{background:rgba(196,30,30,.04);border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.15);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:8px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.ad-erupt::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:3px;height:100%;background:#c41e1e;box-shadow:0 0 8px #c41e1e}
.ad-erupt-label{font-size:8px;color:#c41e1e;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:5px;font-weight:700}
.ad-erupt-body{font-size:11px;color:#ddd;line-height:1.7;font-style:italic}
.ad-erupt.dark{background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.ad-erupt.dark::before{background:#555;box-shadow:none}
.ad-erupt.dark .ad-erupt-label{color:#666}

/* 角色留言 */
.ad-char-note{background:rgba(196,30,30,.02);border:1px dashed rgba(196,30,30,.15);border-radius:10px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;min-height:55px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .25s}
.ad-char-note:active{background:rgba(196,30,30,.06)}
.ad-char-note .note-hint{font-size:10px;color:#555;text-align:center;line-height:1.6;letter-spacing:1px;padding:6px 0}
.ad-char-note .note-text{font-size:11px;color:#ddd;line-height:1.7;display:none;font-style:italic;text-align:center}
.ad-char-note.written .note-hint{display:none}
.ad-char-note.written .note-text{display:block}
.ad-char-note.written{background:rgba(196,30,30,.07);border-style:solid;border-color:rgba(196,30,30,.25)}

/* Siri */
.ad-siri{background:rgba(255,255,255,.02);border-radius:10px;padding:9px 10px;margin-bottom:6px;border-left:2px solid rgba(196,30,30,.3)}
.ad-siri-time{font-size:8px;color:#666;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:3px;font-family:'Courier New',monospace}
.ad-siri-q{font-size:11px;color:#c41e1e;line-height:1.5}
.ad-siri-q::before{content:'"';margin-right:1px}
.ad-siri-q::after{content:'"';margin-left:1px}

/* 日历 */
.ad-cal{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;padding:9px 10px;background:rgba(196,30,30,.04);border-left:2px solid #c41e1e;border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;margin-bottom:6px}
.ad-cal-date{font-size:11px;color:#c41e1e;font-weight:700;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;min-width:45px;flex-shrink:0;letter-spacing:1px}
.ad-cal-info{flex:1;font-size:11px;color:#ccc;line-height:1.5;font-style:italic}

/* 闹钟 */
.ad-alarm{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:8px 10px;background:rgba(196,30,30,.03);border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.1);border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:5px}
.ad-alarm-time{font-size:18px;color:#c41e1e;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;font-weight:200;letter-spacing:1px;flex-shrink:0}
.ad-alarm-info{flex:1;margin-left:10px;font-size:10px;color:#888;line-height:1.4}
.ad-alarm-sw{width:24px;height:14px;background:#c41e1e;border-radius:8px;position:relative;flex-shrink:0;box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(196,30,30,.5)}
.ad-alarm-sw::after{content:'';position:absolute;right:2px;top:1px;width:11px;height:11px;background:#fff;border-radius:50%}

/* 相册 */
.ad-album-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:5px}
.ad-album-lb{font-size:9px;color:#888;min-width:42px}
.ad-album-bar{flex:1;height:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden}
.ad-album-fill{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#c41e1e,#ff6b6b);box-shadow:0 0 4px #c41e1e}
.ad-album-num{font-size:10px;color:#c41e1e;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;font-weight:700;min-width:48px;text-align:right}

/* 蜡烛 */
.ad-candle{text-align:center;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;cursor:pointer;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,rgba(196,30,30,.06),transparent);border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.1)}
.ad-candle-flame{font-size:38px;animation:flameFlick 2s ease-in-out infinite;display:inline-block;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(255,140,0,.6))}
.ad-candle.out .ad-candle-flame{animation:none;opacity:0.2;filter:grayscale(1)}
@keyframes flameFlick{0%,100%{transform:scale(1) rotate(-2deg)}50%{transform:scale(1.1) rotate(2deg)}}
.ad-candle-tip{font-size:10px;color:#666;letter-spacing:1px;margin-top:6px}
.ad-candle.out .ad-candle-tip{color:#c41e1e;font-style:italic}

/* 月亮 */
.ad-moon{text-align:center;padding:16px;margin-bottom:10px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,rgba(255,255,255,.04),transparent);border-radius:12px}
.ad-moon-ic{font-size:38px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 16px rgba(255,255,255,.25));animation:moonGlow 4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes moonGlow{0%,100%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 16px rgba(255,255,255,.25))}50%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 24px rgba(255,255,255,.45))}}
.ad-moon-tx{font-size:11px;color:#888;font-style:italic;margin-top:8px;line-height:1.6}

/* 时间穿梭 */
.ad-timeline{padding:10px;background:rgba(196,30,30,.02);border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.08);border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:10px}
.ad-tl-tt{font-size:9px;color:#c41e1e;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:8px;text-align:center;font-weight:700}
.ad-tl-slider{width:100%;height:3px;background:#1a0000;border-radius:2px;position:relative;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.15)}
.ad-tl-fill{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#444,#c41e1e);border-radius:2px;transition:width .3s}
.ad-tl-dot{position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:11px;height:11px;background:#c41e1e;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 8px #c41e1e;transition:left .3s}
.ad-tl-labels{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:8px;font-size:7px;color:#555;letter-spacing:1px}
.ad-tl-current{text-align:center;margin-top:8px;font-size:11px;color:#ccc;font-style:italic;min-height:34px;line-height:1.6}

/* 写信 */
.ad-write{background:rgba(196,30,30,.02);border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.15);border-radius:10px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:10px}
.ad-write-tt{font-size:10px;color:#c41e1e;letter-spacing:1px;margin-bottom:8px;font-weight:700}
.ad-write textarea{width:100%;min-height:60px;background:#000;border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.2);border-radius:6px;padding:8px;color:#ddd;font-size:11px;font-family:inherit;resize:none;outline:none;line-height:1.5}
.ad-write textarea:focus{border-color:rgba(196,30,30,.5)}
.ad-write-btn{margin-top:8px;width:100%;padding:9px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c41e1e,#8b0000);border:none;color:#fff;border-radius:8px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;font-weight:600}
.ad-write-btn:active{transform:scale(.97)}

/* 隐藏 */
.ad-hidden-hint{text-align:center;padding:12px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.4);border:1px dashed rgba(196,30,30,.25);border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:10px;cursor:pointer;font-size:9px;color:#666;letter-spacing:1px;line-height:1.6;user-select:none}
.ad-hidden-hint:active{background:rgba(196,30,30,.05);color:#c41e1e}
.ad-hidden-hint.progress{background:rgba(196,30,30,.08);color:#c41e1e}
.ad-hidden-content{display:none;background:rgba(196,30,30,.08);border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.3);border-radius:10px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px;font-size:11px;color:#ddd;line-height:1.8;font-style:italic;position:relative}
.ad-hidden-content.show{display:block;animation:hiddenReveal 1.5s}
@keyframes hiddenReveal{from{opacity:0;filter:blur(8px)}to{opacity:1;filter:blur(0)}}
.ad-hidden-content::before{content:'🔓 已解锁';position:absolute;top:6px;right:10px;font-size:8px;opacity:.5;letter-spacing:1px}

/* 关闭 */
.ad-close-btn{display:block;width:100%;padding:10px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.2);background:transparent;color:#666;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:3px;cursor:pointer;margin-top:6px;flex-shrink:0;font-family:inherit}
.ad-close-btn:active{background:rgba(196,30,30,.06);color:#c41e1e}

/* 底部 */
.ad-nav{flex-shrink:0;height:50px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0a0a0a,#000);display:flex;justify-content:space-around;align-items:center;border-top:1px solid rgba(196,30,30,.12);position:relative;z-index:2}
.ad-nav .item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:1px;cursor:pointer;border:none;background:transparent;padding:4px 4px;font-family:inherit;border-radius:6px}
.ad-nav .item .ic{font-size:15px;line-height:1;opacity:.3;transition:all .25s;filter:grayscale(1)}
.ad-nav .item .lb{font-size:7px;color:#444;letter-spacing:1px;transition:color .25s}
.ad-nav .item.on .ic{opacity:1;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(196,30,30,.7))}
.ad-nav .item.on .lb{color:#c41e1e}
.ad-nav .item:active{transform:scale(.92)}

.ad-home-bar{position:absolute;bottom:4px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:80px;height:4px;background:rgba(196,30,30,.2);border-radius:999px;z-index:5}

/* Toast */
.ad-toast{position:absolute;bottom:65px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(10px);background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c41e1e,#8b0000);color:#fff;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:14px;font-size:10px;opacity:0;transition:all .3s;z-index:200;pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(196,30,30,.4)}
.ad-toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
</style>
</head>

      <div class="ad-ecg">

function updateTimeline(pct){

}
function tlMove(e){
  var rect=tlSlider.getBoundingClientRect();
  var x=(e.touches?e.touches[0].clientX:e.clientX)-rect.left;
  var pct=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,x/rect.width*100));

}

}
